findings.message:
[P2] Plaintext gate also blocks loopback development

`requestIsHttps` returns false for `http://localhost:8000` (see `src/handler_test.ts:289`), so this wrapper makes the documented `deno task dev` listener return 426 for the UI and the loopback WebAuthn flows. The task only requires rejecting production plaintext; exempt loopback hosts (or gate the check on a production/forwarded host) so local Deno development keeps working.

main.ts:4-14

[P2] Loopback bind breaks Deno Deploy recovery ingress

The same `main.ts` is the dynamic Deno Deploy recovery entrypoint (`scripts/deploy_deno_api.ts`), whose HTTPS ingress connects to the process from outside the process loopback interface. Binding `Deno.serve` to `127.0.0.1` makes the public `/api/health` check in `scripts/verify_deployment.ts` unreachable and fails the retained recovery deployment; keep the loopback bind for the VPS path but select `0.0.0.0` (or an env-configurable host) for Deploy.

main.ts:22-22

summary: The change closes direct public plaintext access by binding to loopback and rejecting non-HTTPS requests, but the gate also blocks documented loopback development and the hardcoded loopback bind affects the shared Deno Deploy recovery entrypoint.

evidence: main.ts:4-14 returns 426 before invoking passportHandler whenever requestIsHttps is false, so plaintext requests are rejected before credential or session handling.
main.ts:22 binds Deno.serve to 127.0.0.1, so an external probe to port 8000 cannot establish a connection while the co-located Caddy proxy can.
requestIsHttps upgrades Caddy's X-Forwarded-Proto https hop, so canonical HTTPS traffic still reaches the handler.
